summary.en: Today is the opening day of the Moving Police box project. The Detective Boys, Haibara, Conan, and Kogoro are all there to celebrate in different ways, the Detective Boys as guests of honor, and Kogoro mainly because of the MC, Kanon Aoshima. Meanwhile, Conan and Kogoro have to pick up Ran, so Conan asks Haibara to help look after the Detective Boys.
